bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage
test -f scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-collect-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-collect; then echo ARCHIVE_JOB_ALREADY_REGISTERED; exit 73; fi
if pgrep -f '^/usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py' >/dev/null;then echo ARCHIVE_JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING;exit 74;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-collect-20261114 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=43200 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --channel-username theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV --recent-limit 3
echo ARCHIVE_JOB_SUBMITTED=YES
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
echo USERBOT_OWNER_UNCHANGED=YES
